status.main_product: Power plant equipment and industrial engineering systems
status.scope_reason: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is a core player because it has entered into a strategic collaboration agreement with Norway's Hystar AS for the phased local manufacturing and indigenisation of PEM electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India.
status.evidence: According to a press release by BHEL, the company entered into a strategic tie-up with Norway's Hystar AS in August 2026 to enable the phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of PEM electrolyser systems in India.

claims.claim: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Norway's Hystar AS on August 13, 2026, to enable the phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of Hystar's patented, high-efficiency PEM electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India, as reported by Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited.
claims.source: BHEL Official Press Release (https://www.bhel.com/bhel-enters-strategic-tie-hystar-norway-pem-electrolyser-systems) and BSE Corporate Filing (https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/7b442020-83fa-419f-8fe0-d597f03460db.pdf)

claims.claim: A strategic technology partnership between Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited and Hystar AS announced in August 2026 brings Hystar's patented PEM technology to the Indian market, which features a guaranteed stack-level efficiency of 47.5 kWh/kg H2 and system efficiency of 51.1 kWh/kg H2 at 100% load.
claims.source: Hystar Official Technology Specifications (https://hystar.com/ and https://hystar.com/eos/)

claims.claim: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Norway-based Hystar AS on August 13, 2026, to enable phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India, though the planned manufacturing capacity and production timelines were kept confidential and omitted from the exchange filing.
claims.source: BHEL Corporate Filing & Disclosures (https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/7b442020-83fa-419f-8fe0-d597f03460db.pdf) and Energdive Market Reports (https://www.energdive.com/news/bhel-hystar-sign-agreement-for-pem-electrolyser-technology)

claims.claim: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Hystar AS in August 2026 to enable the phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India, as reported by BHEL.

A Strategic Collaboration Agreement announced in August 2026 between Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited and Norway-based Hystar AS, which targets the phased indigenisation, local manufacturing, and deployment of Hystar's patented high-efficiency Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) electrolyser technology for green hydrogen projects in India.

The company signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Norway-based Hystar AS in August 2026 to enable phased local manufacturing and indigenisation of PEM electrolyzer systems for green hydrogen projects in India, though the financial details of this transaction were kept confidential.

The company reported an overall corporate revenue of ₹33,782 crore and a net profit after tax of ₹1,578 crore for FY 2025–26, but its official regulatory filings in October 2026 note that no specific commercial manufacturing milestones or order inflows have been recorded yet for the newly established green hydrogen electrolyzer segment.
claims.note: regulatory filings in October 2026 noting no specific milestones or order inflows for the green hydrogen electrolyzer segment

claims.claim: The company announced a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Norway-based Hystar AS on August 13, 2026, to enable phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of PEM electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India, combining Hystar's PEM technology with Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited's engineering and project execution capabilities.

On 13 August 2026, Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited signed a strategic collaboration agreement at its corporate office in New Delhi with Norway's Hystar AS to enable the phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of PEM electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India.

Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is setting up a new manufacturing facility for integrating the equipment of its electrolyser packages at Karkhiyaon, Varanasi, with balance-of-plant design and supply handled by its Project Engineering & Systems Division unit located in Hyderabad.
claims.corrected: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited has shelved its plan for a new manufacturing facility for integrating the equipment of its electrolyser packages at Karkhiyaon, Varanasi, with balance-of-plant design and supply handled by its Project Engineering & Systems Division unit located in Hyderabad.

claims.claim: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Norway's Hystar AS on August 13, 2026, to enable phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of PEM electrolyser systems for green hydrogen projects in India, according to an official disclosure filing with the stock exchanges.
